fieldRules.asset_id: Operation asset UUID; explicit UNKNOWN with reason if unavailable
fieldRules.person_id: Target UUID, affected UUID list for inventory-level rejection, or explicit UNKNOWN with reason
fieldRules.recipe_version: Pinned revision/version; not the Recipe schemaVersion
fieldRules.expected_geometry_identifier: Reference geometry identifier/coordinates, or NOT_AVAILABLE with reason
fieldRules.actual_geometry_identifier: Actual rejected input or newly detected geometry identifier/coordinates; distinguish absent, ambiguous and not detected
fieldRules.raw_checksum: Record expected original SHA-256, actual byte SHA-256 and measurement status; NOT_MEASURED if unread. RAW name means Original bytes even for non-RAW assets.
fieldRules.reason: Actual rejection code and concise meaning
fieldRules.timestamp: Actual execution UTC ISO-8601 timestamp, not source-review time
fieldRules.test_id: Executed harness test ID linked to path ID; a defined path is not an executed test

geometryIdentifier.scope: Diagnostic only; never replaces asset/checksum/UUID binding, geometry comparison or real-person validation

paths.name: Save
paths.requiredPositive: Same asset/SHA and complete UUID-to-geometry mapping; permitted correction values may change.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject asset/checksum mismatch, UUID/geometry mutation, overlap or inventory loss before committing.
paths.sourceLimit: Data-boundary guards; Native persistence and all correction adapters are not proven.

paths.name: Reload
paths.requiredPositive: Reload and validate every stored version/history entry against the asset and first inventory reference.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject corrupt hidden/non-current version even when current version is valid; preserve stored rows/files.
paths.sourceLimit: Semantic reload guards are not Native restart/visual verification.

paths.name: Restart
paths.requiredPositive: New process/store instance restores persisted asset/SHA/UUID/geometry without depending on prior memory.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject persisted mismatch after restart; never synthesize an empty project or guess an identity.
paths.sourceLimit: Source load boundary only; actual application termination/relaunch and restored selection NOT_RUN.

paths.name: Conflict Version
paths.requiredPositive: Valid stale-base conflict versions preserve same inventory and remain separate from the current head.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject mismatched person/geometry/asset/SHA before inserting a conflict branch; preserve existing branches.
paths.sourceLimit: Workspace version storage only; not a completed Native conflict UI.

paths.name: Conflict Resolution
paths.requiredPositive: Resolution submits through the same validated commit/CAS path using explicit current version.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject resolution that rebinds identity or bypasses CAS; choosing a branch grants no identity exemption.
paths.sourceLimit: Shared commit boundary exists; Native person-conflict resolution UI is not implemented/proven.

paths.name: Undo
paths.requiredPositive: Move history cursor without silently regenerating UUIDs; reuse the remembered inventory when reanalyzing before the first portrait entry.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject rebound targets or a save that removes the last remembered inventory; preserve rejected draft.
paths.sourceLimit: Fork after Undo can become an unsavable draft when inventory would be lost; safe resolution UI/persistent inventory redesign is not implemented.

paths.name: Redo
paths.requiredPositive: Restore the saved Recipe values for the same UUID/geometry inventory after moving the cursor forward.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject hidden restored targets with changed binding; do not apply old values to another target.
paths.sourceLimit: Cursor/source guards only; rendered Undo/Redo coherence on Native remains unexecuted.

paths.name: Hidden History
paths.requiredPositive: Validate all history entries and all backend versions, not only visible current/head; retain the identity reference across cursor changes.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject a mismatched hidden entry or whole-checkpoint replacement that loses all portrait inventory.
paths.sourceLimit: The current saved-history guard is not a new persistent person-inventory schema or completed recovery UI.

paths.name: Asset Switch
paths.requiredPositive: Invalidate old person selection/reference before switching and load the new asset's validated inventory.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject old portrait on another asset/SHA; a failed switch/load must not leave the prior person active.
paths.sourceLimit: Windows can inspect data-boundary mismatch but cannot execute Native selection/UI reset.

paths.name: Person Reselect
paths.requiredPositive: Explicitly select a known UUID only after fresh proxy validation against the saved inventory.
paths.requiredNegative: Unknown UUID, failed verification or ambiguous detection clears the earlier selection and stops correction.
paths.sourceLimit: Synthetic UUID/geometry tests do not prove the reselected real person or mask is correct.

paths.name: Recipe Copy
paths.requiredPositive: A same-photo copy may preserve inventory and change supported values only through validated save boundaries.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject a bound portrait recipe copied to a different asset/SHA, or same-photo UUID/geometry mutation; do not auto-retarget.
paths.sourceLimit: Copy rejection at existing save/preset boundaries is not a generic Recipe Copy UI or cross-photo person batch implementation.

paths.name: Export Fixed Recipe
paths.requiredPositive: For portrait-bearing export, pin Recipe/revision and asset/SHA; reload trusted ProjectStore checkpoint and require its exact revision/current parameters/resolved Original URL and first inventory continuity, then use Original with fresh person analysis and before/after checksum.
paths.requiredNegative: Reject missing/mismatched Original, rebound UUID/geometry, ambiguous masks or unsupported correction; never publish proxy/partial Final.
paths.sourceLimit: Persisted checkpoint verification applies to portrait-bearing plans only. A newer saved revision causes old plan rejection, never substitution with latest Recipe; durable historical job-snapshot retry NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Pinned guards do not verify actual RAW/pixels/Proxy-Final/Native execution.
